Replay

Existing Pi deployment

2 min readOdin × GodotPage source ↓
On this page ↓
Reproduce the service buildState and credentialsAcceptance scope

The selected host is the existing NixOS Pi at 10.0.0.10, reached as pi over SSH port82. Deployment changes belong in ~/data/code/pi-nix. Its existing GameServers and Coturn services remain the shared infrastructure.

The deployed gateway preserves wss://mc.laserturtle.net:62127/rtc and forwards legacy paths to GameServers.Signal on literal loopback port62129. The exact /replay-room/dockyard path forwards to the existing Odin/Godot Replay Room implementation on loopback49740. Nginx terminates TLS with the existing ACME certificate. The Elixir SIGNAL_LOCAL_PROXY=1 option explicitly binds its private listener to loopback; the ordinary direct-TLS default is retained. No new authority protocol implementation or router port is required.

The deployment and current same-network acceptance are recorded in tests/replay_dockyard/online/public-deployment-report.json. Actual public WSS, authenticated forced TURN, full state/acknowledgement/cleanup, observer and reconnect checks passed. A STUN-only attempt did not establish direct gameplay on the reference network; its diagnostics remain separate. Outside-network acceptance and human co-op feedback are still required.

Reproduce the service build#

Use the deployment helper to snapshot current intended working sources into a new persistent directory outside the repository. It verifies the pinned engine archive, records every selected source hash and refuses overwriting a snapshot. The snapshot retains the existing compiler/nixpkgs lock and uses the exact Godot4.7.1 Linux ARM64 archive. A service build does not rebuild the client game.

Shell
python3 examples/replay_dockyard/deploy/stage_room_source.py \
  --engine-archive /ABSOLUTE/VERIFIED/CACHE/box3d.tar \
  --out /PERSISTENT/NEW/SERVICE/SOURCE

Point the replay-room input in pi-nix at that snapshot, then update only the changed inputs. Build on the Pi through its remote Nix store, with bounded parallelism, so the unrelated user VM is not used:

Shell
cd ~/data/code/pi-nix
nix flake update game-servers replay-room
NIX_SSHOPTS='-p 82 -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes' \
  nix build .#nixosConfigurations.pi.config.system.build.toplevel \
  --store ssh-ng://pi@10.0.0.10 --eval-store auto --builders '' \
  --max-jobs 1 --cores 1 --no-link --print-out-paths -L

Check the actual native build, private service startup, authenticated Room flow, complete-state agreement and shutdown before activation. The existing deploy-rs workflow supports a remote build and automatic rollback:

Shell
cd ~/data/code/pi-nix
nix run github:serokell/deploy-rs -- .#pi --remote-build

The coordinated switch restarts the legacy signal listener and nginx; existing connections can reconnect. Verify both protocol paths afterward. Nginx starts after both private backends and does not race a reload against the previous public62127 listener.

State and credentials#

dockyard-room.service uses private state and runtime directories. It runs a writable private copy of the frozen SDK project because initial module loading creates owned reload copies. The database remains under its state directory. Initial database creation is explicit; if it disappears after initialization, the service refuses to replace it silently. Recover the database as an operator.

Systemd supplies Coturn's existing server-only signing secret with LoadCredential; it never enters a Nix derivation, client checkpoint, URL or log. Room issues and refreshes authenticated member credentials with a600-second TTL. The game content/cohort must match the selected frozen browser artifact.

Acceptance scope#

A check from this home's public address back into the same router is hairpin traffic. Record that separately from a genuinely outside-network client. Performance qualification remains on the declared M3/browser profile; building a control service for Linux ARM64 does not admit native physics crossplay or inherit that performance result. Human cooperative play feedback is separate.
